# @canopy/wasm

The Canopy core in Rust as WebAssembly for Cloudflare Workers and browsers: the policy engine, the event matcher, query canonicalization and the EJSON codec, with the same semantics as the server.

For Cloudflare Workers and browsers, where a Node-API addon cannot load. It exports what `@canopy/native` exports, so `engineFromBinding` of that package wraps it behind the API of the TypeScript packages.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/wasm
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

<!-- snippet: declare const module: WebAssembly.Module -->

```ts
import { instantiate } from "@canopy/wasm"

// On Workers: import module from "@canopy/wasm/canopy_wasm_bg.wasm"
const core = await instantiate(module)
const open = core.Filter.fromEjson('{"status": "open"}')
open.matchesEjson('{"status": "open", "total": 120}') // true, decided in Rust
```
